data.name: Pad See Ew with Beef
data.description: Pad See Ew with Beef is a popular Thai stir-fried noodle dish featuring wide rice noodles, tender beef slices, Chinese broccoli, and a savory blend of soy and oyster sauces, delivering a flavorful and hearty meal.
instructions: Slice the beef thinly against the grain and marinate with soy sauce and a pinch of white pepper for 10 minutes.
Soak the dried wide rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes or until soft, then drain and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a large wok over high heat until hot.
Add the sliced beef to the wok and stir-fry quickly until it just begins to brown, then remove from wok and set aside.
Add more vegetable oil to the wok if needed and stir-fry the garlic until fragrant.
Add the drained noodles to the wok and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes to heat through.
Return the beef to the wok with the noodles.
Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar to the wok and stir well to combine all the ingredients evenly.
Push the noodles and beef to one side of the wok, add beaten egg to the empty side and scramble until partially cooked, then mix into the noodles.
Add the Chinese broccoli (gai lan) and continue stir-frying until the leaves are wilted and the stems are tender-crisp.
Season with additional soy sauce or sugar if needed and serve immediately.
